turns.content: Let a=BC, b=CA, and c=AC. Use the angle-bisector theorem at C with AD=229 to relate a, b, and c.
Given that AC and AC are relatively prime, determine the divisibility relation and write BC in terms of a positive integer parameter.
Substitute the parameterization into the perimeter equation and express c in terms of k and AD=229.
Use the perimeter a+b+c=2019 to derive a positive-integer factorization involving b+229 and k+1.
Enumerate the positive factor assignments of 2019, enforce b>0 and k>0, and identify the unique admissible values of b and k.
Compute all three side lengths and report BC, checking that the triangle is scalene and satisfies the original conditions.
